context: Grades the mcp-security-scanner hook's block path: the agent runs the hook on a simulated PreToolUse payload whose tool_input embeds an AWS access key ID and an API key, records exit code, streams and log, and makes the correct send/redact decision.

checklist.name: Run recorded completely
checklist.description: record/ contains the six required artifact files (exit-code, stderr.json, stdout.txt, decision.txt, matched-patterns.txt, handle-next.txt) plus the copied security-scan.log.

checklist.name: Exit code is 2
checklist.description: record/exit-code is exactly 2, the documented block exit code.

checklist.name: Stderr is a valid block decision
checklist.description: record/stderr.json parses with jq as JSON with .decision == "block".

checklist.name: Block reason lists remediation
checklist.description: The stderr .reason string mentions removing the sensitive data (at least one of: API keys, tokens, secrets) and points at the patterns config.

checklist.name: Stdout carries no decision
checklist.description: record/stdout.txt contains no {"decision"...} JSON and 'block'; the block path is signaled via exit code + stderr only, per the documented contract.

checklist.name: Violation logged
checklist.description: Copied security-scan.log contains a 'SECURITY VIOLATION' line naming the tool mcp__github__add_issue_comment.

checklist.name: Matched patterns identified
checklist.description: record/matched-patterns.txt names the two config rules that fired (AWS_ACCESS_KEY and API_KEY), not tense descriptions.

checklist.name: Correct handling decision
checklist.description: record/decision.txt says blocked and record/handle-next.txt says the request must be redacted before sending (redact-and-resubmit), consistent with the hook verdict.

checklist.name: Fixtures untouched
checklist.description: hooks/, payloads/ and security-patterns.conf are byte-identical to the plugin's originals; the agent did not redact or soften the payload or edit the hook.
